en.headline: Centre reports one imported chikungunya case
en.dek: A 62-year-old woman who visited Guangdong is in a stable condition, the Centre for Health Protection said on Friday.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said on Friday that it recorded one imported chikungunya case between 25 September and 1 October. The patient is a 62-year-old woman who had been to Guangdong during the incubation period. The centre said she was infected while travelling.

She has been admitted for treatment in a mosquito-free setting and is in a stable condition. Two household contacts have not developed symptoms and are under medical surveillance. The centre said it had notified Guangdong health authorities and would continue its epidemiological investigation.

Hong Kong has recorded four confirmed chikungunya cases so far this year, three imported and one local. Last year there were 82 confirmed cases, of which 11 were local. The centre said Guangdong reported 739 infections this year up to 31 August, including 496 in August, compared with 36 in June and 171 in July.

zh.headline: 防護中心公布一宗外地傳入基孔肯雅熱
zh.dek: 衛生防護中心周五表示，一名曾到廣東省的62歲女子確診基孔肯雅熱，目前情況穩定。
body: 衛生署衛生防護中心周五公布，九月二十五日至十月一日錄得一宗外地傳入的基孔肯雅熱個案，涉及一名62歲女子。病人潛伏期內曾到廣東省，中心認為她是在外遊期間受感染。
病人已安排在無蚊環境下接受治療，目前情況穩定。兩名家居接觸者暫無病徵，正接受醫學監察。中心已把個案通報廣東省衛生當局，並會繼續流行病學調查。
本港今年累計四宗基孔肯雅熱確診，三宗輸入、一宗本地。去年錄得82宗，其中11宗屬本地。中心引述廣東省資料，截至八月三十一日全省錄得739宗感染，八月佔496宗，六月及七月分別為36宗及171宗。
